# Hammer

Internal ID: Hammer | Type: Tool | Source: Player crafting menu | Usage: Building | Wielding: Two-handed | Crafting Materials: Wood x2, Stone x2

# Introduction

The Hammer is used to construct objects such as fires, Workbench, buildings, and furniture. The recipe is unlocked from the start of the game, and no crafting station is required to craft it.
To see the list of craftable, refer to Building.

## Upgrade Information

• stat: Durability | Quality 1: 100 | Quality 2: 200 | Quality 3: 300

• stat: Crafting recipe | Quality 1: 3 Wood2 Stone | Quality 2: 1 Wood1 Stone | Quality 3: 2 Wood2 Stone

• stat: Workbench level | Quality 1: 1 | Quality 2: 2 | Quality 3: 3

## Notes

• Use right click to open the crafting menu. Due to this, you cannot block while a hammer is equipped.

Categorias: Tools, Crafting, Building
